**Acceptance criteria verified:**

✅ `classesForPort()` includes Neopanamax for Singapore (max draft 16m ≥ 15m)  
✅ `classesForPort()` excludes Neopanamax from Gdynia (max draft 13m < 15m)  
✅ All 26 tests pass

The changes have been committed with commit `6045463`.
